daily_progress.notes: Outcome-sensitive sitting and proceeding proof should start with official daily progress pages, then reconcile to Hansard and Journals.

hansard_debates.notes: Official Parliament Hansard is the primary source. Fallbacks are discovery or gap-fill candidates only and do not replace official sitting reconciliation.

journals.notes: Weekly, sessional, index, and historic journal surfaces need separate proofs because index/volume organization differs by period.

members_parties_seating_contacts.notes: Official Parliament current/former member, party, seating, roll, and contact downloads remain identity starting points; election and Wikidata/Wikipedia sources stay in the authority-source manifest as supporting inputs.

order_paper_questions_business_sitting_p.notes: Order Paper, oral questions, written questions, business statements, and sitting programme are official current-business sources and should be sampled without bulk download in the next track.

papers_presented_ajhr.notes: Official papers-presented/current-papers pages should lead; AJHR fallback options are historical and require rights/coverage checks before acquisition.

parliamentary_rules_procedure.notes: Standing Orders, Speakers' Rulings, determinations, and procedure material are authoritative for procedural models but do not by themselves prove proceedings.

petitions.notes: Official petition pages should be sampled for current petition metadata and outcomes; publication of submission-like personal content needs rights review.

select_committees.notes: Committee reports, submissions/advice, meetings, submitters, and videos are official sources but may contain third-party personal information and publication constraints.

video_audio_calendar.notes: Video, audio, live/recorded Parliament in Action pages, calendars, and meeting metadata should be treated as metadata-first sources unless media rights are separately cleared.

reconciliation.boundary_note: This inventory extends Parliament website dataset discovery. NZ legislation and Gazette acquisition remain outside this repo and belong to the adjacent legislation corpus. HathiTrust and Internet Archive are recorded only as excluded baselines here.

scope_note: Inventory of Parliament-hosted and credible fallback datasets beyond NZ legislation and the Gazette. This is a discovery manifest only; it does not perform bulk acquisition or claim historical completeness.

seed_fetcher_handoff.expected_proof: One official index page, one sitting-day/detail page, and one downloadable/PDF or transcript reference when available, with timestamps and content hashes.
One index and one detail/sample for Order Paper, oral questions, written questions, business statement, and sitting programme without enumerating entire archives.
One weekly journal index/detail proof plus one historic/session/index surface proof, preserving source classification and no completeness claim.
One current papers/papers-presented sample and one AJHR fallback/source-discovery sample with rights and coverage notes.
One committee list, one report detail, one submissions/advice listing, one meeting record, and one video metadata reference where public.
One official member list sample plus former members, roll, party, seating, and contact download metadata where accessible.
